description_en: Cancels a translation task that is currently running
description_zh: 本接口用于取消正在运行中的翻译任务
kebab_example: aliyun realtranslationagent cancel-translation-task --task-id f9c35b0453b --api-key sk-500007 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CancelTranslationTask

parameters.help_en:
The task ID.
The TaskId is returned after a task is submitted by calling SubmitTranslationTask.
Only running tasks can be canceled
parameters.help_zh:
任务ID。
SubmitTranslationTask任务提交后会返回TaskId。
仅可取消正在运行的任务
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The API key, the identity of member accounts. You can obtain it from the RuiYiBao console
parameters.help_zh: API密钥，标识成员账号身份，可通过睿译宝工作台获取
parameters.name: api_key
